params.description: List of urls we should match against

patterns.description: List of Match pattern compatible strings to match against

regexPatterns.description: List of regular expression patterns to match against URLs

visitsCount.description: Number of times the matched URL has been visited this session

totalVisitsCount.description: Number of matched visits this session, counted across every host and pattern registered by any active openURL message. Pair with a broad pattern such as "*://*/*" to count all page loads.

url.description: The full spec of the URL that was navigated to

host.description: The host (nsIURI.host) of the URL that was navigated to

isAddressBarUrlNavigation.description: Whether the navigation was a direct navigation to a URL via the address bar (typed, pasted, autofilled, or picked from the dropdown as a bookmark/history/top-site match), as opposed to a search query submitted through the address bar, a synced-device (remote tab) pick, a link click, a redirect, or other programmatic navigation.

anyOf.description: Happens every time the user loads a document that is Reader Mode compatible
Fires when the user adds a bookmark through any UI path. Bulk and non-interactive sources and tag operations are ignored, and it fires at most once per operation. Does not fire in private windows.
Happens every time the user adds a bookmark from the URL bar star icon
Fires when the user navigates to a URL that is already bookmarked. Does not fire in private windows.
Happens when the user either creates a new bookmark folder or saves a bookmark into a user-created folder. Does not fire for tag operations or while a private window is active.

Happens when the user saves, updates, or uses a credit card or address for form autofill

items.description: Events that should trigger this message. String values correspond to ContentBlockingMilestone events and number values correspond to STATE_BLOCKED_* flags on nsIWebProgressListener.

source.description: When the source of the trigger is home/newtab

willShowDefaultPrompt.description: When the source of the trigger is startup

defaultPromptSuppressed.description: At startup, true when the default browser prompt would have shown but was disabled by the setToDefaultPrompt Nimbus feature
